uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: For every 7% missing HP, this Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def are increased (up to 10 times; maximum at 70% missing HP or more). Gains a stacking Def/SpDef buff for every 7% HP missing. Stacks up to 10 times.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 2s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.

The user drops large rocks at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 1s. Drops large rocks on the designated area. When this move hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for a short time.

The user splits open the ground in a line towards the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and decreasing their movement speed by 60% for 2s. A curved wall of rock is then created at the designated location that remains for up to 3s. When the wall of rock is created or destroyed, opposing Pokémon near the wall are damaged and their movement speed is decreased by 60% for 2s. The user can use this move again to destroy the wall of rock early. Splits open the ground toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and creating a barricade of rock. Activating this move again removes the barricade.
Strengthens the movement speed decrease from this move to 80%. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

The user becomes unstoppable as they smash their shell over 0.8s, reducing their base Defense and Sp. Def stats to 0 and converting 40% of the value lost to bonus Attack and Sp. Atk respectively for 4.5s. The user's movement speed is increased by 75% for the duration of the buff (decaying by 5% every 1s; minimum 55% increased movement speed before the buff ends). All modifiers (except emblem color bonuses) work with 0 base Defense and Sp. Def for the duration of this buff. Convert a set percentage of Defense and Sp. Defense into Attack and Sp. Attack and increase movement speed for a short time.
Strengthens the conversion rate from lost Defense and Sp. Def to bonus Attack and Sp. Atk to 50%. Increased conversion rate.

The user slashes once with their claw while dashing slightly in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. Targets hit by Fury Cutter receive a mark for 9s that stacks with subsequent Fury Cutter hits (up to 3 times). Subsequent hits of this move on marked targets have 20% increased damage (maximum 40% increased damage on the third and subsequent hits from this move). Additional stacking damage from this move is always rounded up. Slashes enemies with claws, dealing damage to them. Hitting the same enemy multiple times in succession with this move increases the damage dealt.

The user launches a cluster of rocks in the designated direction which expands into a trap of levitating rocks on the first opposing Pokémon or wall hit, or after traveling their max distance. This trap deals damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 4s (up to 8 times). Subsequent hits on targets hit by the trap within 1.5s have 15% increased damage; this damage increase stacks with subsequent hits from that trap (maximum 105% increased damage on the eighth hit). Additional stacking damage from subsequent hits for each trap is always rounded up. Throws many small rocks. When a rock hits an enemy or when the rocks have flown their full distance, a zone of many levitating rocks is created dealing slowly-increasing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect.

The trap of levitating rocks remains for 1s longer; this move can hit up to 10 times (maximum 135% increased damage on the tenth hit). Also decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 35% for 1s. Increases the duration of this move's effects and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

The user dashes and attacks with crossed claws three times in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon and shoving them for 0.2s with each attack. The third hit stuns opposing Pokémon for 1.5s if they are shoved into a wall. Dash forward with crossed claws, dealing damage to enemies multiple times and shoving them. Leaves enemies unable to act if they hit an object when shoved.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s. Reduced cooldown.

The user becomes unstoppable as they summon a whirlwind of rocks around them, gaining a shield, and stunning nearby enemies for 1s. For 10s after, the whirlwind of rocks damage nearby opposing Pokémon every 1s. If the user receives damage during Rubble Rouser, the user deals additional revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon (2s CD). The value of the shield gained from Rubble Rouser is equal to 40% max HP + 600. Gain a shield for a short time and leave nearby enemies unable to act, dealing damage over time to them. If the user receives damage while this move is in effect, the move deals additional hits to nearby enemies.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Rubble Rouser
source.originalDescription: The user becomes unstoppable as they summon a whirlwind of rocks around them, gaining a shield, and stunning nearby enemies for 1s. For 10s after, the whirlwind of rocks damage nearby opposing Pokémon every 1s. If the user receives damage during Rubble Rouser, the user deals additional revenge damage to nearby opposing Pokémon (2s CD). The value of the shield gained from Rubble Rouser is equal to 40% max HP + 600. Gain a shield for a short time and leave nearby enemies unable to act, dealing damage over time to them. If the user receives damage while this move is in effect, the move deals additional hits to nearby enemies.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rubble Rouser は 行動不能・スタンを付与する、妨害無効になる、シールドを付与する、継続ダメージを与える。
